title: Liquid Grain Cavern
description: A single mangled 'east' dirt hit chopped into 16 grains and pitched into the mid/high register, then poured into a cavernous wet space where euclid-gated stutters and reverse grains drift on perlin currents. Over 23-32 cycles the grain count, crush grit, and reverse probability swell and recede so the cloud breathes through the room.
code:
setcpm(124/4)
stack(
  s("east*2")
    .chop("<16 24 12 32>/8")
    .speed("<2 -2 1.5 -1 3 -2.5>")
    .note("<0 7 5 -2 12 3>/7")
    .struct("x(<5 7 3 9>,16,<0 2 3>)".slow(2))
    .ply("<1 2 1 3>/11")
    .sometimesBy(perlin.slow(13).range(0.1, 0.5), x => x.speed(-1))
    .degradeBy(perlin.slow(17).range(0, 0.35))
    .coarse(perlin.slow(19).range(1, 7).round())
    .crush(saw.slow(23).range(16, 5))
    .hpf(420).lpf(perlin.slow(11).range(1800, 7200)).resonance(6)
    .pan(perlin.slow(7).range(0.05, 0.95))
    .off(0.0625, x => x.add(note(12)).speed(-1).gain(0.5).pan(rand))
    .room(perlin.slow(29).range(0.55, 0.95)).roomsize(8).orbit(2)
    .delay("0.6:0.1875:0.78").delaytime(perlin.slow(31).range(0.12, 0.28))
    .gain(0.85)
)
